title: Band squat

steps.text: Stand on the middle of the band with your feet hip-width apart.
steps.cue: Stand on the middle of the band.

steps.text: Hold one end in each hand at your shoulders.
steps.cue: Hold the ends at your shoulders.

steps.text: Bend your knees and sit your hips back, keeping your chest up.
steps.cue: Bend your knees. Sit your hips back, chest up.

steps.text: Stand back up and squeeze your glutes.
steps.cue: Stand up and squeeze your glutes.

steps.text: Keep a chair behind you if you want something to aim for.
steps.cue: A chair behind you gives you something to aim for.

mistakes: Lifting your heels off the floor.
regression: Do it without the band, down to a chair.
stopIf: Stop if you feel pain in your knees, hips or back.

anatomy.why: The front of the thigh and the buttocks straighten the knees and hips to stand you up against the band.

sources.title: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e: 11.6 Appendicular muscles of the pelvic girdle and lower limbs
